sermon.title: Power of God - February 11, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Faith must rest on the power of God, not human wisdom. Michael uses lightning and electricity to show the difference between knowing about God and being changed by Him. Zacchaeus, Jacob, the Emmaus disciples, the woman who touched His garment, the Shunammite and the sinful woman all show that being near Jesus is not the same as direct contact. Keep pursuing Him until it happens.

faqs.question: Is experiencing God harmful?
faqs.answer: No; unlike electrocution, it is good and changes you for the rest of your life.

faqs.question: Why did Zacchaeus want to see Jesus?
faqs.answer: He wanted to see a miracle; a famous person was coming to his house.

faqs.question: What did Zacchaeus do after meeting Jesus?
faqs.answer: He gave half his goods to the poor and restored fourfold.

faqs.question: Did wrestling change Jacob?
faqs.answer: No; his hands were on the man the whole time but nothing happened until God changed him.

faqs.question: How should we come to Jesus?
faqs.answer: With the right attitude, with humility.

faqs.question: Did the Shunammite’s promise come right away?
faqs.answer: No; she had to keep loving her old man before anything happened.

faqs.question: Why was the foot-washing humbling?
faqs.answer: She kissed and anointed His feet, the ugly part of the body; religious people didn’t approach Jesus that way.

faqs.question: Who loves more?
faqs.answer: The one forgiven a million dollars rather than $100.

faqs.question: What is the encouragement to viewers?
faqs.answer: Come in direct contact with Jesus and do not give up at step one.
